svg.title: Jaekit walkthrough, frame 4: The agent works
svg.desc: Frame 4 of 5, The agent works: $ ha check docs/specs/password-link --baseline AC-1 AC-1 baseline fail_as_expected (seq 2) before the change $ ha check docs/specs/password-link AC-1 AC-2 AC-1 check pass (seq 3) after the change AC-2 check pass (seq 4) still passes $ spar run --stage candidate --base f46020c … Spar review round $ spar gate docs/reviews/password-link/01-candidate … $ ha note docs/specs/password-link review --gate … noted: review (seq 5) gate recorded $ ha done docs/specs/password-link - status: **complete** (exit 0) - completion record: seq 6 completion recorded — The agent works. You do not type these commands. The agent runs them while you wait; ha records each run. Spar reviewers read the goal, checks and diff. Spar does not certify or deploy. Fictional example; not a recording of a real run.
